principles: Match the physical product type before choosing action, setting and camera.
Use product name only as identity; preserve visible design from the image provided to the video generator.
Never invent electric operation, materials, safety claims, accessories or included features.
Show realistic hands or model only when appropriate to the selected product type.
One standalone English prompt per concept and duration, with Malay Malaysia speech only when chosen.

stockpot.action: place the pot on a stable hob and stir a simmering soup with a ladle
stockpot.camera: medium cooking shot then close-up of pot rim and soup

saucepan.action: gently heat and stir a small quantity of sauce
saucepan.camera: side close-up showing handle and sauce

wok.action: stir-fry vegetables with a spatula in the curved wok
wok.camera: three-quarter angle capturing tossing and wok shape

frying_pan.action: pan-fry food in a shallow pan with believable utensil contact
frying_pan.camera: overhead cooking detail and side profile

pressure_cooker.action: show ingredients placed inside the unpowered cooker and the lid being positioned
pressure_cooker.camera: clear full product and lid detail

electric_cooker.action: show ingredients being added to the removable cooking vessel and a finished dish presented
electric_cooker.camera: wide counter shot and product close-up

steamer.action: place food onto a steamer tray and reveal steamed food after cooking

grill_pan.action: turn food with tongs on the grill pan surface
grill_pan.camera: low angle showing grill surface and cooking action

rice_cooker.action: measure rice into the inner pot and show a cooked rice serving
rice_cooker.camera: top-down rice detail and full appliance

baking_tray.action: arrange pastry on a baking tray and present baked result
baking_tray.camera: overhead tray detail and oven-safe placement only when confirmed
